# Data Model
<!-- docs.AI knowledge doc — auto-generated by speckit.init -->

## Overview

There is no database. All state is file-based, version-controlled, and human-readable. State lives at three scopes:

| Scope | Location | Lifetime |
|-------|----------|----------|
| **Session** | In-memory (AI context) | One conversation |
| **Feature** | `specs/<NNN>-feature-name/` | Per feature |
| **Project** | `CLAUDE.md`, `specs/memory/` | Permanent |

---

## Feature Artifact Model

Each feature gets a numbered directory under `specs/`. All artifacts within are optional except `spec.md`.

```
specs/
├── feature.json                      # Pointer to active feature directory
├── memory/
│   └── constitution.md               # Non-negotiable governance rules
└── <NNN>-feature-name/               # e.g. 001-user-authentication/
    ├── spec.md                       # User stories, acceptance criteria
    ├── plan.md                       # Technical design, architecture decisions
    ├── tasks.md                      # Dependency-ordered task list (T001, T002…)
    ├── research.md                   # Technical decisions, alternatives considered
    ├── data-model.md                 # Entities, relationships, validation rules
    ├── contracts/
    │   └── <contract-name>.md        # API specs, interface contracts
    └── checklists/
        └── <checklist-name>.md       # Requirements quality validation
```

### `specs/feature.json`

```json
{
  "active": "specs/001-user-authentication"
}
```

All skills resolve the current feature directory from this file before reading or writing artifacts.

---

## Project-Level State (CLAUDE.md)

The project `CLAUDE.md` stores:
- **Workflow rules**: Which skills to invoke, in what order
- **Tracker config** (under `## Tracker` heading): organization URL, project name, PAT/API key
- **Active iteration**: Sprint / milestone pointer
- **Custom constraints**: Non-obvious project rules that override skill defaults

---

## Template Resolution Order

When a skill generates an artifact, it looks for a template in this order:

1. `specs/.templates/<template-name>.md` — project custom (user-edited)
2. Prompt-provided inline content — runtime override
3. `templates/<template-name>.md` — repo default fallback

Templates available:

| Template | Used By |
|----------|---------|
| `spec-template.md` | `/ai-radija-specify` |
| `plan-template.md` | `/ai-radija-plan` |
| `tasks-template.md` | `/ai-radija-tasks` |
| `constitution-template.md` | `/ai-radija-constitution` |
| `checklist-template.md` | `/ai-radija-checklist` |

## Knowledge Docs (docs.AI/)

Pre-knowledge documentation suite generated once per project by `/ai-radija-generate-pre-knowledge-docs`. These files are consumed by AI agents at session start to avoid re-exploring the codebase.

| File | Content |
|------|---------|
| `1_README.AI.md` | Project overview, quick-start |
| `2_ARCHITECTURE.AI.md` | Architecture, tech stack |
| `3_REPO_STRUCTURE.AI.md` | Directory layout |
| `4_DATA_MODEL.AI.md` | This file |
| `5_INTEGRATIONS.AI.md` | External integrations |
| `6_GLOSSARY.AI.md` | Domain terms |
| `7_DEPLOYMENT.AI.md` | Deployment + install |
| `8_TESTING.AI.md` | Testing strategy |
| `9_WORKFLOWS.AI.md` | Golden Path |
| `10_CONSTRAINTS.AI.md` | Compliance, constraints |
| `11_ONBOARDING.AI.md` | First-session checklist |
